text: {"assertions":["A hang-on-exit issue in the deploy command affected clients pinned to the v1 SDK.","The hang-on-exit was caused by schema drift between the migration and the model.","The fix involved regenerating the model from the migration and pinning the checksum.","PR #3429 on the fix/hang-on-exit-1 branch implemented the fix for the hang-on-exit issue.","The hang-on-exit issue could be reproduced by deploying the sample project and waiting.","The deploy command is covered by tests in tests/cli/test_deploy.py.","The error rate decreased from 7.1% to under 0.03% after applying the fix."]}
